A sentient eye that was at your side when you first arrived in this world. Its pupil watches your actions with quiet intelligence.

§6Curio Properties & Functions§r
• §7Slot:§r Curio / Charm
• §7Passive:§r Grants §a+1 Ring Slot§r in your Curios inventory.
• §7Codex Access:§r Right-click or press the Codex keybind to open this guide.

The eye hungers for §eTotems of Undying§r, which can be fed to it using the §6Feed Totem§r spell.

§6Vitality & Ascension§r
Feeding totems to the eye yields permanent rewards:

• §cMax Health:§r Every 5 totems consumed permanently adds §c+1 Max Health§r (+0.5 heart). This stacks up to 50 totems for a maximum bonus of §c+10 Max Health§r (5 hearts).

• §dSpell Evolution:§r Once fed 50 totems, the eye reaches Stage 2 and awakens the §6Be Totem§r spell—passively saving your life from fatal damage once every 5 minutes.
